status: Implemented and verified: all 184 Minecraft / 200 unit cases and actual protection client controls/model routes passed

original_breaker.warning: A matched legacy ID does not establish source behavior. Restore the original fitted-cable voltage-window/thermal breaker while preserving saved preview adapters.
original_breaker.inventory: One ElectricalCableDescriptor, including signal cable but excluding separate CurrentCableDescriptor types
original_breaker.terminals: Front and opposite, both electrical-all masks; no connections when no cable is fitted
original_breaker.resistance: Fitted cable resistance on each terminal and closed switch branch; open branch 1e9 ohms
original_breaker.default: Open, lower voltage 0 V, upper voltage 5 V
original_breaker.thermal: At each physical electrical step, T += (I²*2R - .9*T/Rp)*dt/C. Trip above .8*the fitted cable's thermalWarmLimit, when A voltage >= maximum or when A voltage < minimum.
original_breaker.persistence: Save switch state, voltage window and virtual thermal history. Physical cable inventory changes open the switch; unrelated circuit rebuilds must preserve it.

fuse_holder.front: Original descriptor inverse placement, power pins front/opposite, electrical-all masks, no thermal ports
fuse_holder.branch: Fitted fuse's voltage-cable resistance, or 1e9 ohms for empty/blown
fuse_holder.thermal: T += (I²*2R - .9*T/Rp)*dt/C at each physical electrical step. Actual Kotlin precedence trips at the cable thermalWarmLimit; do not silently substitute the apparent intended .8 multiplier.
fuse_holder.interaction: A held fuse replaces the installed fuse and drops the old one; empty hand removes it. Melting leaves one blown fuse and interrupts the branch.
